title: MND releases image of Russian military aircraft in Taiwan's ADIZ
summary: Taipei, Nov. 19 (CNA) Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense (MND) on Thursday released a surveillance image of a Russian military aircraft, as it detected two more sorties of Russian aircraft entering Taiwan's air defense identification zone (ADIZ) earlier in the day, marking the second such incident this week.

title: KMT aims for Friday passage of NT$20,000 cash handout bill
summary: Taipei, Nov. 19 (CNA) The opposition Kuomintang (KMT) is seeking to secure passage Friday of a bill to distribute NT$20,000 (US$607) in cash to every eligible resident, drawing a warning on Thursday from the Cabinet that fiscal planning should not be driven by election considerations.
